headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty ended lower as global AI sell-off weighed on market sentiment.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Global sell-off in AI stocks weighed heavily on market sentiment.
Concerns over potential Fed rate hikes created headwinds for equities.
Record FII buying previously helped benchmark indices reach 9-month highs.
Automobile companies are adjusting product prices to manage ongoing input cost pressures.
whatHappening: In the session on November 20, Sensex dropped around 250 points in early trade with Nifty dipping below 25,450.
Maruti Suzuki announced price increases for select vehicle models due to rising cost pressures.
Mahindra Last Mile Mobility is targeting an IPO within the next 18 months while planning new product launches.
InvIT market activity is accelerating with 4 to 5 trusts expected to launch public offers by March 2027.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices faced downward pressure amid global AI stock sell-offs and rate hike signals. Despite recent market volatility, strong FII inflows had driven indices to multi-month highs earlier. Key stock updates include Maruti Suzuki hiking select vehicle prices and Mahindra Last Mile Mobility planning an IPO in 18 months.
